purpose: Single approval registry for shared UI. Developers and AI must read this before every UI change.
changePolicy: Reuse an approved component before creating one.
New reusable patterns belong in components/ui (or an explicitly registered feature composite).
Add the component path, purpose, accessibility contract and any package owner here in the same pull request.
A registry edit proposes approval; the tech lead must review its design, accessibility and tests before merge. Do not auto-approve unrelated packages or widen exceptions to pass checks.
Use className for layout and documented variants. Do not override control colors, typography, borders or interaction states in individual screens. Extend the central component instead.

accessibility: Labels must be visible or have a clear accessible name. Associate validation text with aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
Do not use placeholder text as the only label. Icon-only controls need an accessible name.
Retain keyboard navigation and visible focus. Never use color as the only status indicator.
Dialogs require focus containment/restoration, Escape handling, a labelled title and background interaction control.
Tables require scoped headers and a responsive overflow container.
Check narrow mobile widths and 200% zoom.
layout: Use existing card, label, badge and spacing patterns from app/globals.css.
Use lucide-react for icons; no second icon library.
No new dropdown library, CSS framework or component kit without a registry review.

components.name: Button
components.useFor: All actions. primary for the main action, secondary for alternatives, danger for destructive actions, plain for icon/tab/inline controls. Use explicit type=submit for form submission.
components.accessibility: Preserve semantic HTML, accessible names, keyboard operation and visible focus.

components.name: Input
components.useFor: Text, number, search, checkbox, radio and native date inputs. Specialized password/phone/DOB fields must use their registered wrappers.
components.accessibility: Preserve semantic HTML, accessible names, keyboard operation and visible focus.

components.name: Select
components.useFor: All dropdowns. Native select with option/optgroup children. Country, state, timezone, filters and page-size selectors must compose this component.
components.accessibility: Preserve semantic HTML, accessible names, keyboard operation and visible focus.

components.name: Table
components.useFor: All data tables. Use scoped headers, an accessible name/caption, responsive overflow and empty/loading/error states.
components.accessibility: Preserve semantic HTML, accessible names, keyboard operation and visible focus.

components.name: Textarea
components.useFor: All multiline entry. Associate labels and error/help text.
components.accessibility: Preserve semantic HTML, accessible names, keyboard operation and visible focus.

components.name: ChoicePicker
components.useFor: Remote organization/patient choice using search plus the approved Select; not a custom combobox.
components.accessibility: Keep label, loading, no-results and error states.
